skills.name: Dataset Discovery
skills.author: OpenConstruction
skills.description: Find construction datasets by task, modality, annotation type, object class, license, source, and access constraints.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Construction AI task or research goal.

inputs.name: modality
inputs.description: Preferred data modality such as images, video, point clouds, BIM, text, or sensor data.

inputs.name: object_class
inputs.description: Target object, class, element, hazard, activity, or asset type.

inputs.name: annotation
inputs.description: Required annotation style such as bounding boxes, masks, labels, trajectories, or metadata fields.

outputs.name: candidate_datasets
outputs.description: Ranked dataset candidates with title, id, summary, license, source link, fit score, fit reasons, and checks.

outputs.name: selection_notes
outputs.description: Short notes about fit, access, metadata gaps, and follow-up checks.

outputs.name: next_actions
outputs.description: Suggested MCP tool calls for inspecting or comparing the strongest candidates.

review.security_notes: Uses public OpenConstruction metadata only. No external account access and no code execution.

workflow: Capture the user's task, modality, annotation, object class, license, and access constraints.
Search dataset records with the most specific constraints first.
Retrieve promising records and inspect source metadata for access, license, and citation signals.
Compare candidates by task fit, data modality, annotation match, evidence, and reuse constraints.
Return a concise ranked list with links and note any missing metadata that should be checked manually.

ui.name: task
ui.label: Task
ui.placeholder: helmet detection, point cloud segmentation, bridge inspection

ui.name: modality
ui.label: Modality
ui.placeholder: image, video, point cloud, BIM, sensor

example_prompts: Find open datasets for construction safety helmet detection.
Find point cloud datasets for construction scene segmentation.
Which datasets can support equipment detection with reusable licenses?
